text:
maria: Kicking off regional weight shift for release v2.14.1 — prefer eu-west first. Change window is 1h.

jake: Quick note: we'll do weights 5 -> 25 -> 50 -> 100 with 3m observation per step. If error_rate > 0.8% OR latency_p95 increases > 20% rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: release=v2.14.1 target=blue variant, region=eu-west, pool=dedicated-gpu-2

anya: I'm pinning the model variant to v2.14.1-quant to avoid inference float diffs. Confirming config pushed to prod-config.

maria: routerctl plan:
```
routerctl shift --from=green --to=blue --region=eu-west --steps "5,25,50,100" --pause 180s --healthchecks "p50,p95,error_rate" --sticky-sessions cookie
```

jake: Also enabling conn draining on green with a 120s graceful_timeout. Session stickiness uses cookie-based pin; we'll honor header X-Experiment.

sre_oncall: I'll monitor alerts. If 5xx spikes > 0.5% within a step, hold and rollback if it persists for >1 step. Also set circuit breaker to 60% error rate for the region.

router-bot: Traffic shift execution starting: step=5% -> blue. timestamp=1812500060

maria: Observability checklist: per-route latency, token-level cost, kv-cache hit ratio, model errors. Anya, can you watch model-level rejects?

anya: On it. I'll validate model outputs against canary prompt set and post results in 10m.

deploy-bot: step complete: 5% -> blue. health: OK. p95 latency delta +2.1%. errors 0.12%.

jake: Proceed to 25% after 3m hold. No db migrations in this release, so safe to increment.

router-bot: step starting: 25% -> blue. timestamp=1812500240

sre_oncall: Alert: error_rate increased to 0.9% for route /generate in eu-west. Rolling back to previous step and pausing.

maria: Pausing shift. Initiating rollback to green 100%. Can someone flash rollback note in release notes and notify PS?

deploy-bot: Rollback started: target=green region=eu-west. timestamp=1812500305

anya: Re-running canary prompts locally, I see a mismatch on a subset of prompts that causes soft-fail tokenization. Reverting quant tweak in v2.14.1-quant-revert.

jake: Good catch. Once revert is published I'll trigger a new canary and follow the same step increments. For now we keep green at 100% and schedule a postmortem if needed.

maria: Filing follow-up: create a short postmortem and include threshold tuning. Also add a config flag to disable quant tweak per region.

sre_oncall: Confirmed: green back to 100%. No active alerts. Marking incident as mitigated for now. :white_check_mark:

maria: Thanks all. New plan: revert quant tweak, run canary in eu-west with 1% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% to be more conservative. Will post ETA later.

jake: I'll update release notes: "v2.14.1: initial rollout paused due to inference error spike in eu-west; quant tweak reverted; will reattempt with conservative weights." 

deploy-bot: Note: change-window still open until 1812503600. Ensure any reattempt is within window or request extension.

anya: A11y: I'll add the failing prompts to the regression set so this doesn't slip again.

maria: Closing thread for now. Ping here when reattempt scheduled.
